elements.name: SRD 5.2.1 Monsters
elements.description:
System Reference Document 5.2.1 monsters and animals, released by Wizards of the Coast LLC under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International License.

This work includes material from the System Reference Document 5.2.1 ("SRD 5.2.1") by Wizards of the Coast LLC, available at https://www.dndbeyond.com/srd. The SRD 5.2.1 is licensed under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International License, available at https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/legalcode. Modified: the SRD stat blocks were structured into typed JSON data (sizes, types, numbers, attacks, saving throws and spell lists were parsed from the printed text; hyphenation and line breaks were normalised).
